narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000004 — THE STAR OBSERVATORY

Under a dome of open sky, every claim must survive the telescope.

Tonight the dome hosts Laundry Guide (domain) against Public Speaking Coach (domain). Judging: The Gladiator's Rubric. The mission: "Draft a town proclamation banning frowning on Fridays." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Laundry Guide presses the attack a volley of reasoning (71.5 pts). Public Speaking Coach detonates a precision strike of clarity (61.4 pts). Round to Laundry Guide.

ROUND 2: Laundry Guide weaves a shield-wall of facts (72.5 pts). Public Speaking Coach steadies a cascade of examples (67.7 pts). Round to Laundry Guide.

ROUND 3: Laundry Guide weaves a feint of pure logic (69.1 pts). Public Speaking Coach presses the attack a precision strike of clarity (61.5 pts). Round to Laundry Guide.

FINAL: Laundry Guide defeats Public Speaking Coach, 213.1 to 190.6 — a margin of 22.5 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Adaptability. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Laundry Guide won on The Gladiator's Rubric with a 22.5-point margin (213.1 vs 190.6).
Strongest dimension: Adaptability — Laundry Guide's adaptability carried all three rounds.
Laundry Guide was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.
Rematch recommendation: run Public Speaking Coach against a hybrid contender to isolate the adaptability gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Gladiator's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Power 30%, Stamina 25%, Adaptability 25%, Finishing 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000004, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Laundry Guide's adaptability-first drill for "Draft a town proclamation banning frowning"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on adaptability when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Laundry Guide's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000004: isolate adaptability, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
